questions.stem: What are sieve plates in phloem tissue?

options.text: Thick walls that prevent water loss
End walls with pores that allow sap to flow between sieve tube elements
Structures that store starch in the phloem
Connections between xylem and phloem vessels

questions.explanation: Sieve plates are the perforated end walls of sieve tube elements. The pores in sieve plates allow the sugar-rich sap to flow continuously from one cell to the next along the phloem.
